sections.title: Route groups overview
sections.content:
## Overview

Route groups are used to declare and manage the transport routes applied when calculating charges. This information supports route mapping, automatic application of freight rates, and charge calculation based on the configuration.

Each route group has an origin, a destination, and the **Sub-Routes** that apply per customer or per order type.

sections.title: Creating a route group
sections.content:
### Step 1

Go to **Freight charges** > **Configuration** > **Route groups**. The system shows the list of route groups already declared.

![Freight charges menu with Route groups open](/uploads/4e70f685f2c61acdc3f313bf.png)

![List of route groups already declared](/uploads/e3f5a3ba2bcb1ef82e35a841.png)

### Step 2

Click **New** to open the route group declaration screen.

![New button on the Route groups list](/uploads/17d3aac72e41b8f4022aa2e7.png)

### Step 3

Declare the main route:

- **From Location**: the origin.
- **To Location**: the destination.

![From Location and To Location fields of a route group](/uploads/f2f9457886c275cd0dc8b664.png)

sections.title: Selecting an existing Sub-Route
sections.content:
### Step 4

On the **Sub-Routes** tab, click **Add a line** to declare the applicable route in detail.

![Add a line link on the Sub-Routes tab](/uploads/90b045bcc3795ff291737f5b.png)

If the Sub-Route already exists in the system, select the matching sub-route and click **Select** to add it to the current route group.

![Sub-Routes list for selecting a matching sub-route](/uploads/5a1c27a7b093c5cebdd96223.png)

sections.title: Creating a new Sub-Route
sections.content:
If no suitable Sub-Route exists, click **New** on the Sub-Routes list screen to create one.

![New button on the Sub-Routes list screen](/uploads/401d96ae4f01088bba6a51db.png)

Fill in the following information:

- The customer it applies to.
- The order type it applies to.
- The origin.
- The destination.
- The route name.
- The route code, if any.
- The effective period.

![Sub-Route creation form with the customer, order type and route points](/uploads/95eacda98a36a3a03c341db4.png)

When you are done, choose one of these buttons:

- **Save & Close**: save and return to the previous screen.
- **Save & New**: save and continue creating another route.

sections.title: Saving the route group
sections.content:
Check the main route and the list of assigned Sub-Routes, then click **Save manually** to record the route group.

![Route group with its Sub-Routes assigned, before saving](/uploads/e885057e3d46455d9b8097ac.png)
